subject: does an app need to be redeployed every time the data are changed in order to be real-time updated?

messages.author: d972fd69aaa3d952
messages.subject: does an app need to be redeployed every time the data are changed in order to be real-time updated?
parts:
Hi,

I recently started using R Shiny and shinyapps.io for my job.
Basically, I still have a free shinyapps.io account, exploring the options it gives.

I have a question:
Let's say that I've created an app and also deployed it on shinyapps.io.
If the data (either they come from a db with values that have been changed in the meanwhile or from a csv file that I have changed) used on the server.R part are changed, do I need to re-deploy the app so that the app on the cloud is updated to the new data?
I mean I don't make any change on the code (which would definitely need a redeployment); I need to update the data used. In fact, the data are very often used for the purpose I need the R Shiny apps, so I would otherwise need to manually redeploy the app often.
If so, do you know a way to automate this re-deployment (since if I put a deployApp() command, I'm asked to press y/n). I've found this https://github.com/rstudio/rsconnect/pull/236 which I haven't tried yet but should probably be a way (?).

Thank you for any help.

John

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: does an app need to be redeployed every time the data are changed in order to be real-time updated?
parts:
If you are bundling your data with your code, then anytime you want to update the data you will need to deploy.
If your code loads the data remotely, then you can create logic to reload the remote data at an interval.
